FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Clear answers to the most common questions
FAQ.q1: Do I need a Social Security Number?
FAQ.a1: Not necessarily. We accept both SSN and ITIN. If you have a valid IRS identification number (ITIN), you can use Credit Legacy AI without issues.
FAQ.q2: What is a CPN and why don't you accept it?
FAQ.a2: A CPN (Credit Profile Number) is a number sold as an SSN alternative, but using one is illegal under FCRA and federal law. We automatically reject any CPN attempts to protect our users.
FAQ.q3: How long does it take to see results?
FAQ.a3: First results typically appear in 30-45 days. Full repairs can take 3-6 months depending on the case. Every situation is unique.
FAQ.q4: Does it work in Puerto Rico?
FAQ.a4: Yes. Credit Legacy AI works in all 50 US states and Puerto Rico. We comply with all applicable regulations.
FAQ.q5: Is this a service or software?
FAQ.a5: Credit Legacy AI is a DIY (Do It Yourself) platform with artificial intelligence. You do the work, we give you the most powerful tools on the market.
FAQ.q6: What happens if I cancel my plan?
FAQ.a6: You automatically downgrade to the Monitoring plan ($9.99/mo) that keeps your credit watched. If you want to leave completely, you can do it with one click.
